title: 会议讨论 · 讲图、澄清与建设性追问
description: 20 句原创科研英语练习，涵盖会议问答、解释图表、澄清问题、提出建议与回应分歧。均为交流模板，请按真实项目和现场问题调整，不对应特定论文或实际结果。

source.title: 科研小盒原创科研英语课程 · 2026-10

sentences.en: I would appreciate a little clarification about your comparison group.
sentences.zh: 我希望您能进一步说明一下比较组的情况。
sentences.note: would appreciate 是礼貌提出请求的结构；about 后接需要澄清的具体内容。
sentences.question: Ask a presenter to clarify how the comparison group was selected.

sentences.en: I understand your question as a concern about the sampling strategy.
sentences.zh: 我理解您的问题是在关注采样策略。
sentences.note: understand A as B 用于复述对问题的理解，便于对方及时纠正。
sentences.question: Restate a difficult audience question before answering it.

sentences.en: The horizontal axis shows the variable used to compare these observations.
sentences.zh: 横坐标轴展示了用于比较这些观测值的变量。
sentences.note: used to compare 是过去分词短语，修饰 variable；正式答问时补充变量名和单位。
sentences.question: Explain the horizontal axis of a figure from your project.

chunks.zh: 用于比较这些观测值的

sentences.en: Let me explain the color scale before discussing the broader pattern.
sentences.zh: 我先解释色标，再讨论整体模式。
sentences.note: Let me explain 是简洁的引导语；before discussing 明确讲图顺序。
sentences.question: Introduce a color scale to someone unfamiliar with your data.

sentences.en: I would separate your question into design and interpretation.
sentences.zh: 我会把您的问题分为研究设计和结果解释两部分讨论。
sentences.note: separate...into... 将复杂问题拆成可回答的部分；would 使回应更柔和。
sentences.question: Divide a question with several parts into a clear response structure.

sentences.en: That is a useful distinction between measurement uncertainty and biological variation.
sentences.zh: 这一区分很有帮助，它区分了测量不确定性与生物变异。
sentences.note: a distinction between A and B 指对两个概念的区分；that 承接对方刚提出的观点。
sentences.question: Explain the difference between measurement uncertainty and biological variation.

chunks.en: between measurement uncertainty and biological variation.
chunks.zh: 在测量不确定性与生物变异之间

sentences.en: I agree with the concern but would interpret the evidence more cautiously.
sentences.zh: 我认同这一关切，但会更谨慎地解释这些证据。
sentences.note: agree with 先回应对方的具体观点；but would 后接自己的判断方式。
sentences.question: Respond politely when you share a concern but differ on its interpretation.

sentences.en: An alternative explanation would involve differences in the sampled environments.
sentences.zh: 另一种可能的解释是采样环境存在差异。
sentences.note: An alternative explanation 引入替代解释；would involve 保留假设性。
sentences.question: Offer an alternative explanation without dismissing the speaker’s interpretation.

sentences.en: The evidence would be stronger if the comparison included an independent dataset.
sentences.zh: 如果比较纳入一个独立数据集，证据会更有力。
sentences.note: would...if...included 构成假设条件句，用于提出建设性建议。
sentences.question: Suggest one feasible way to strengthen the evidence in a study.

sentences.en: My suggestion is to examine the assumption most relevant to this conclusion.
sentences.zh: 我的建议是考察与这个结论最相关的假设。
sentences.note: My suggestion is to... 用不定式明确建议采取的动作；most relevant 指出优先顺序。
sentences.question: Which assumption would you recommend checking first, and why?

sentences.en: I would need to check the analysis before giving you a precise answer.
sentences.zh: 我需要先核查分析，才能给您准确回答。
sentences.note: would need to check 说明需要核实的步骤；before giving 避免临场猜测。
sentences.question: How would you respond when the answer depends on an unchecked detail?

sentences.en: That question goes beyond the conditions covered by the current study.
sentences.zh: 那个问题超出了当前研究涵盖的条件。
sentences.note: go beyond 指范围超出；covered by 为过去分词定语，具体限定研究条件。
sentences.question: Explain which aspect of an audience question falls outside your study.

sentences.en: A useful next step would be to test that idea in another setting.
sentences.zh: 有价值的下一步是在另一种情境中检验那个想法。
sentences.note: would be to... 把建议转化为明确行动；another setting 可指地点、人群或研究条件。
sentences.question: Propose a new setting that would meaningfully test the same idea.

sentences.en: For this audience, I would start with the biological question and then introduce the model.
sentences.zh: 面向在场听众，我会先介绍生物学问题，再引入模型。
sentences.note: start with...and then... 清楚安排讲解顺序；For this audience 用于说明信息层次的选择。
sentences.question: How would you explain your analysis to researchers outside your field?

sentences.en: The technical detail matters because it affects which comparisons are valid.
sentences.zh: 这项技术细节很重要，因为它影响哪些比较是有效的。
sentences.note: matters because 将技术细节与推断后果相连；which comparisons are valid 是宾语从句。
sentences.question: Choose one technical detail and explain why a general audience should care.

sentences.en: Let me return to the specific comparison that addresses your question.
sentences.zh: 让我回到能够回应您问题的那项具体比较。
sentences.note: return to 用于把讨论拉回相关证据；that addresses...说明选择该比较的理由。
sentences.question: Bring a discussion back to the evidence most relevant to the question.

sentences.en: Your suggestion could help distinguish between competing interpretations of the same pattern.
sentences.zh: 您的建议可能有助于区分对同一模式的不同解释。
sentences.note: could help 表达建议的潜在价值；competing interpretations 指都需要评估的备选解释。
sentences.question: Explain how a colleague’s suggestion could resolve an uncertainty.

sentences.en: I would welcome your thoughts on the most informative follow-up comparison.
sentences.zh: 我很希望听听您认为哪项后续比较最有信息价值。
sentences.note: would welcome your thoughts on... 是邀请具体反馈的表达；informative 强调比较能提供什么信息。
sentences.question: Invite a discussant to suggest the most informative next comparison.

chunks.en: on the most informative follow-up comparison.
chunks.zh: 关于最有信息价值的后续比较

vocabulary.meaning: 有信息价值的；有启发性的

sentences.en: We can discuss the implementation details after the session if more time is needed.
sentences.zh: 如果需要更多时间，我们可以在会议环节结束后讨论实施细节。
sentences.note: after the session 提供继续讨论的具体时机；if...needed 说明何时采用该安排。
sentences.question: How would you continue a detailed discussion when question time is limited?

sentences.en: My brief answer is that the interpretation depends on the comparison being made.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，这一解释取决于所进行的比较。
sentences.note: My brief answer is that... 用于先给结论；being made 后置修饰 comparison。
sentences.question: Give a short answer first, then name the condition that changes it.
